title: Not as absorbent as I would expect
text:
Not as absorbent as I would expect. This material is big, nice size, and great for those large pots and pans that need drying. It is also great to dry your larger platters.

However, I feel the absorbency does not react as well as it should for a drying towel. I believe that the material is just too flat, without any fiber to pick up the wetness. Material to absorb needs to have material that is not flat, but with more cloth fibers to sop up the wetness.

I love the bright green color. Easy to spot in the laundry crowd..

The good thing? There is a White small band that serves as a ring to HOOK the towel somewhere.
